# EWS hosting telemetry uses fixed categories and literal host suffixes

The recorder reads a local endpoint URL but increments fixed Office365 or OnPremise label counters. It classifies host_str with ends_with against office365.com, outlook.com, onmicrosoft.com and .microsoft. That literal suffix test is not a proof of provider identity or certificate trust. The direct test checks a loopback host and one Office365 URL, rather than every suffix or the final telemetry payload.

Scope: EWS telemetry hosting classification.
